item.title: India’s first Vande Bharat sleeper train ready for launch on Howrah–Guwahati route
item.description: India’s first Vande Bharat Sleeper Train is set to be launched soon on the Howrah–Guwahati route, the Ministry of Railways announced on Thursday (1 January). The 16-coach rake will comprise 11 AC three-tier coaches, 4 AC two-tier coaches, and 1 first-class AC coach, with a total passenger capacity of around 823, positioning it as a high-capacity premium option for overnight long-distance travel. item.title: BCCI Asks Kolkata Knight Riders to release Mustafizur Rahman from its squad ahead of IPL 2026
item.description: The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has asked Kolkata Knight Riders to release Bangladesh pacer Mustafizur Rahman from its squad ahead of the IPL’s 2026 edition. item.description: Dhurandhar kicked off its fifth week with, once again, a record-breaking day, collecting Rs. 8 crore nett approx on its fifth Friday.
